fields.label: Palette
fields.description: Picking a palette copies its two colours into the fields below, which stay editable. To make your own, type a name and choose Create a new Phenomenon UI Palette: it is saved and appears here from then on.

Blank uses the specification accent. Any colour is safe: the theme derives the hover, the selected wash and the button label from it, and lifts it automatically in dark mode so it stays legible against a dark page.
fields.label: Accent Colour
Chrome Colour
fields.description: The navbar and sidebar ground. Blank uses the specification chrome. The hover step, the selected item, the edge and both text colours are derived from it, so a light chrome gets dark labels automatically.

fields.label: Density
fields.description: Changes control height, row padding and section gap only. Type sizes never change: 13px is the floor at every density.
Dark chrome is the design system: navbar and sidebar form a dark frame around the lit content plane. Light is the one deviation offered, for a client who rejects a dark frame.
fields.label: Chrome
